wiki.title: Elissa Slotkin
wiki.extract: Elissa Blair Slotkin ( SLOT-kin; born July 10, 1976) is an American politician and former Department of Defense official serving since 2025 as the junior United States senator from Michigan. A member of the Democratic Party, she served in the United States House of Representatives from 2019 to 2025.
